summary: The customer called back to complain about a previous agent who was rude and unhelpful when asked about a high bill. The current agent, Rami, apologized, investigated the account, identified that the phone accidentally connected to a border tower for international roaming, and successfully applied a credit to the customer's account to resolve the issue.

evidence.text: We will file a complaint against her.
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: File a complaint against the previous rude agent.

evidence.text: I can apply a credit to your account right now لتصحيح الخطأ.
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Apply a credit to the customer's account to waive the roaming charges.

evidence.text: ولا يهمك سيدي، أنا معك وحاضر أسمعك.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent remained calm, polite, and professional throughout the call, even when dealing with the customer's frustration about the previous interaction.

evidence.text: حقك علي يا سيدي، I completely understand.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent repeatedly apologized for the previous agent's behavior and acknowledged the customer's feelings.

evidence.text: I have applied the credit, and it will show on your next bill.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent successfully diagnosed the roaming issue caused by a border tower and applied a credit to fully resolve the customer's billing concern.

evidence.text: عذراً سيدي، قصدي إنو تلفونك شابك بالغلط على شبكة دولة مجاورة وأنت قاعد ببيتك
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent explained the technical concept of the border tower clearly after initial jargon, though there was some code-switching.

evidence.text: Is there anything else I can help you with today?
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent properly asked if further assistance was needed and closed the call politely.

evidence.text: سيدي، the system shows إنو صار في usage برات البلد الشهر الماضي. Let me look closer... Ah, wait. It was connected to a border tower.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent accurately investigated the account and correctly identified the roaming issue and its cause.

evidence.text: بس ممكن تعطيني رقم الحساب لو سمحت عشان I check the bill right now?
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent followed proper procedure by asking for and verifying the account number before looking up the bill details.

quote.text: والله أنا كتير متضايق من المكالمة اللي قبل شوي.
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: When I asked her to explain again، صارت تحكي بصوت عالي وتتذمر
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: I live in Amman، ما رحت على أي حدود!
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: والله يا ريت عملتولنا waive، لأنو مو ذنبي إنو التلفون شابك على برج تاني!
quote.speaker: Customer

quote.text: Thank you so much، أنت كتير لطيف أحسن من اللي قبلها.
quote.speaker: Customer
